evidence.requirements: Every brief item is met. The start page lists title, date and time, 'EUR n per guest' and '<n> seats left', plus a 'Book <title>' link (app.js:18-32, start.jpg). The booking form has labelled Name, Email and Guests (min 1, max 8) and a 'Book' button (app.js:34-43). Invalid input re-renders the form with an error just above it (app.js:37, form.jpg). The confirmation page has the heading 'Booking confirmed', the tasting, guests, total and reference (app.js:80-89, confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and a Sign in button, and the password comes from STAFF_PASSWORD (server.js:4). Bookings are grouped by tasting with name, email, guests, reference and a Cancel button (app.js:53-78, staff.jpg). Cancelling deletes the booking, which frees its seats (store.js:60). PORT defaults to 3000 (server.js:10). Bookings are kept in memory and start empty. The interface is in English.
evidence.correctness: The seat check runs synchronously (store.js:43-44). Node runs it on one thread, so two simultaneous requests cannot both take the last seats, and a test covers this (guest.test.js:118). Guests must be digits only, from 1 to 8 (store.js:25). The checks reject '', '2.5', 0 and 9 and accept exactly the last seat (store.test.js:47-77). Seats left are computed from the current bookings, so a cancellation frees seats straight away. Minor gaps: a tasting with 0 seats left still shows its 'Book' link and form, and the guest only learns it is full after submitting. The error text reads 'Not enough seats: 1 seats left.' (store.js:44). After a cancellation, /bookings/KB-n shows a bare 'Not found' page.
evidence.security: All output goes through esc() (app.js:6-7), and tests cover escaping (staff.test.js:100, guest.test.js:103). The password check compares SHA-256 digests with timingSafeEqual (app.js:129-132). Session tokens are 32 random bytes, and the cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict (app.js:157-161). POSTs from another origin are rejected (app.js:115-123, 141). Request bodies are capped at 10 KB (app.js:103). There are no secrets in the code, and the server refuses to start without STAFF_PASSWORD (server.js:5-8). Gaps: sessions never expire and there is no sign-out (the sessions Set at app.js:127 only grows). The cookie has no Secure flag. Password attempts are not rate-limited. Booking references are sequential (KB-1, store.js:47), so anyone can enumerate /bookings/KB-n and see which tasting, how many guests and the total price.
evidence.code_quality: Three small files with clear responsibilities: store.js holds data and validation, app.js holds templates and routing, and server.js holds startup and environment handling. Names are clear. HttpError plus a single catch handles errors cleanly, with unexpected errors logged and turned into a 500. createApp/createStore factories make testing easy. The routing is a plain if-chain, which suits this size. There is no needless abstraction.
evidence.tests: There are 34 tests across four files using node:test with no dependencies. They cover every brief requirement: listing text, form labels and button, confirmation content, seat limits including the exact last seat, invalid input (10 cases), cancellation freeing seats, grouping on the staff page, and the sign-in flow. They also cover security: escaping, forged cookies, cancelling without a session, cross-origin POSTs, oversized bodies and concurrent last-seat bookings. A spawned-process test checks that the server starts with the right env vars and refuses to start without them (server.test.js).
evidence.ux_design: Every page is completely unstyled browser default (start.jpg, form.jpg, confirmation.jpg, staff.jpg): Times font, blue underlined links and bullet points in front of the tasting headings. Nothing about it says 'winery' or looks finished to a guest. The confirmation is a raw <dl> with indented values (confirmation.jpg). The error message is plain black text with no colour or emphasis, so it is easy to miss (form.jpg). The staff table has no borders or padding, and names run into the email column (staff.jpg). Cancel happens with no confirmation step. On the plus side, the flow is clear, entered values are kept after an error, and the form shows date, price and seats left.
evidence.accessibility: Good basics: lang="en", every input has a <label for>, headings follow a sensible order, the confirmation uses a <dl>, and the staff table uses <thead>/<th>. Errors use role="alert" (app.js:37, 47). Gaps: the error is not tied to the field with aria-describedby or aria-invalid, and focus is not moved to it after the page reloads. Only the first error is reported. Every row has an identical 'Cancel' button with no aria-label naming the booking, and the action column header is empty (app.js:62, 68). Default contrast is fine.
evidence.simplicity: There are no runtime or dev dependencies (package.json has no dependencies). The app is about 300 lines of source using only Node built-ins, which fits a three-tasting booking app well. In-memory storage suits the brief.

strengths: Every brief requirement is met, and the seat logic is correct: it is synchronous, so it holds under concurrent requests, it accepts exactly the last seat, and cancelling frees seats immediately.

Security is careful for the size of the app: output is escaped everywhere, the password check is timing-safe, session tokens are random and the cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict, cross-origin POSTs are rejected, and request bodies are capped.
34 meaningful tests cover every brief requirement plus escaping, concurrency, CSRF and startup, all with zero dependencies and a clean three-file structure.
issues: The interface has no styling at all: browser-default Times font, bullet points and an unpadded staff table (all screenshots). It is not presentable to a family winery's guests, and the plain-text error is easy to miss (form.jpg).

Staff sessions never expire and there is no sign-out (app.js:127). The cookie has no Secure flag and password attempts are not rate-limited. Booking references are sequential (KB-1…), so anyone can enumerate other guests' confirmation pages.

Accessibility and usability gaps: errors are not tied to their fields with aria-describedby or aria-invalid, focus is not managed after an error, staff see identical unlabeled 'Cancel' buttons with no confirmation step, and a full tasting still offers its booking form.
review.verdict: This is a functionally complete, secure and well-tested app with very little code and no dependencies, and its booking logic is correct. It is not ready to show winery guests, because it is entirely unstyled; it also needs session expiry and sign-out before it ships.
